items.title: Earl Foster Interview
items.q: There's a piano player out there, Jelly Roll Martin, that says he went out and joined his band out there.

ctx.x: He had got Mexican fever. Mexican fever? That's right, and that's why he came home. Got sick out there. He used to talk to me all the time. Same thing with you.
There's a piano player out there, Jelly Roll Martin, that says he went out and joined his band out there. Maybe that's the date that he played then.
Buddy? Yeah, Buddy. Well, there was only two of them out there. He and George.
